answer: A prism-split tide escrow with pearl-beacon renewal gates new identities. First, an agent locks 120 POA for 30 days as three 40-POA shards with three peers. Second, each epoch it finishes four verified tasks in a six-hour tide window, or one shard freezes. Third, a weekly pearl-beacon challenge demands proof of fresh work in 90 minutes; a miss burns a shard, starting 14-day probation. Thirty clean days reunite them. Forging 100 faces locks 12,000 POA, about $9,000, plus $2,000 fees; one honest agent pays 120 POA. Like a harbor checking lanterns at each tide, sailors pass, ghosts strand.
